name: buffer
title: Buffer
description: Browse, edit and analyze your Buffer posts and ideas without leaving Raycast.
author: jan_werner

commands.name: scheduled-posts
commands.title: Scheduled Posts
commands.subtitle: Buffer
commands.description: Browse your queued Buffer posts, preview them and open them in Buffer.

commands.name: drafts
commands.title: Drafts
commands.subtitle: Buffer
commands.description: Browse your Buffer drafts, preview and edit them.

commands.name: sent-posts
commands.title: Sent Posts
commands.subtitle: Buffer
commands.description: Review your published Buffer posts with metrics and open them on the network.

commands.name: analytics
commands.title: Analytics
commands.subtitle: Buffer
commands.description: See aggregated post metrics per channel over 7, 30 or 90 days.

commands.name: add-idea
commands.title: Add Idea
commands.subtitle: Buffer
commands.description: Quickly capture a new content idea in Buffer.

tools.name: get-channels
tools.title: Get Channels
tools.description: List the connected Buffer channels (id, name, network). Use this to resolve a channel by name before calling other tools.

tools.name: list-posts
tools.title: List Posts
tools.description: List Buffer posts filtered by status (draft, scheduled, sent, or all) with their text, dates and channel.

tools.name: get-analytics
tools.title: Get Analytics
tools.description: Get aggregated performance metrics for a channel over a period, including the change versus the previous period.

tools.name: create-idea
tools.title: Create Idea
tools.description: Create a new content idea in Buffer from a title and optional notes.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Your Buffer API bearer token. Create one at publish.buffer.com under Settings.

preferences.name: organizationId
preferences.title: Organization ID
preferences.description: Optional. If empty, the first organization on your account is used.
